items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then there's Ray La Dixie. You had anything you want. And for years no band, you couldn't get a band out of New Orleans because it was too great. [INTERVIEWEE] Why would you leave?

ctx.x: Wait what? Please come on up. It says 305 or 307. Alright. Loxie is coming up. I wonder if he can get him, we can get him. Yeah, when he comes up we'll get himself.

Yeah so, yeah there was some, there was some beautiful days back in them days. Beautiful women, man. Oh. Yeah? And then there's Ray La Dixie. You had anything you want. And for years no band, you couldn't get a band out of New Orleans because it was too great.
